Is your game a group game? If so, then make sure that the Configuration folders are set correctly. The folders can be found in “Put me in ReplicatedStorage (folder) > Configuration” and in each of the plane models, for example “787 > Configuration”. If you have trouble locating the folders, open a customer service ticket for more help.
If you are having trouble setting up your plane, watch this video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n5x0brk8PXM
If you are still having issues, you can read the following:
Claiming Order: If you experience any bugs/issues, contact customer service in the discord above.
Using the plane: If your plane is not working as intended, then make sure you are following these guidelines:
Make sure HttpService is enabled at the game
If you are using a group game, make sure the GroupID is set in BOTH of the configuration folder
The game you are owning is owned by the user you put in the shoppy text box.
Make sure you are not testing in roblox studio, the plane will only work in game.
Using the spawner
Make sure all of the above instructions have been done
If you are using a group game, make sure the Configuration folder in the spawner is set, as well as the Configuration folder in the planes too. All folders must be set

Make sure the model names of the plane are set correctly and correspond with the plane, for example: Edition-x should be named: “edx” The 787 should be named: “787” The 757 should be named: “757” The 737 should be named: “737”
Make sure that the PrimaryPart of the plane model (a value in properties) is set to the “Main” part in the animations folder in the plane.
